note: Built from docs/research/2026-11-07-dobor-agentow.md. Scores go stale within weeks; the user's own journal outweighs this file once a category has trusted stats.
rules: Judge harness + model + access together; the agent kind alone says little.
Review and security audit: give the same area to two different model families. Two harnesses running the same model do not count.

Treat subscription limits as a budget: expensive models for decisions and hard changes, cheaper or local models for mechanical work. Avoid two workers on the same subscription when there is an alternative.
Local models get only simple tasks.
A model with no data here, or an entry marked stale, is unproven: give it a smaller part.
Agents whose status is not ready are out of the pool; tell the user why in one sentence.
Once a category has trusted journal stats (n >= 5), they outweigh this file. Now and then give a part to another agent so new models get a chance.

strengths: Multi-file changes and repo-wide refactors (practitioner consensus).
Planning changes across a whole repository.
weaknesses: Uses about 4x more tokens than Codex CLI on similar tasks (one source).
The Pro plan has a 5-hour window and a weekly cap shared with claude.ai.
claude.trustDialog: Shows a folder-trust dialog in every new worktree.

strengths: Terminal and CI tasks: Codex CLI + GPT-5.5 scored 83.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
codex.permissions: Sandbox read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access plus approval policies; default on-request.
codex.trustDialog: Asks to trust a new folder.

strengths: One harness for many providers. Through GitHub Copilot it reaches Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi models: the easiest way to add a second model family.
weaknesses: No public benchmark scores as of 2026-07.
Copilot multipliers (Claude Opus 4.6/4.7: 27x) burn the monthly allowance fast.
opencode.permissions: Per-tool permissions; opencode run --auto approves what is not denied.

strengths: Google's successor to Gemini CLI for personal accounts; serves Gemini, Claude and gpt-oss models from one binary.
weaknesses: Users report low Starter quotas and fast token use.

strengths: 1M-token context for reading large codebases (API key or enterprise license only).
weaknesses: Personal, Pro and Ultra access ended on 2026-06-18; the successor is agy.

strengths: Minimal, extensible harness with 20+ providers, including local models.
weaknesses: Quality depends entirely on the configured model.
No permission prompts by design (per reviews; unverified).
